topics.title: Nvidia is in talks to invest in Perplexity at a $30B+ valuation
topics.why: It'd be a 50%+ jump from Perplexity's ~$20B round a year ago, and shows chipmakers now betting directly on the AI apps built on top of their hardware.

topics.title: Anthropic starts watermarking all of Claude's output worldwide under new EU AI Act rules
topics.why: Every Claude text response and supported image now carries machine-readable provenance -- a preview of the disclosure standards knowledge workers using any AI tool will soon have to live with.

topics.title: Google ships Gemini 3.7 Flash, halving the price while jumping 16 points on coding benchmarks
topics.why: A cheaper, sharper model landing just 23 days after its predecessor shows how fast the cost of AI-assisted coding is falling for teams shipping software.
